#compdef tui-markdown
# zsh completion for tui-markdown (generated by `tui-markdown --completions zsh`)
_tui_markdown() {
    local -a choices
    local word command=""
    if [[ $PREFIX == -* ]]; then
        case $command in
            *) choices=('--cat:print the rendering and exit (the default when standard output is not a terminal)' '--c:print the rendering and exit (the default when standard output is not a terminal)' '--width:columns for --cat (default\: the terminal'\''s, or 80)' '--w:columns for --cat (default\: the terminal'\''s, or 80)' '--dump:print the page as the screen shows it (theme background, margins) at --width, with no terminal needed' '--max-width:widest text column, 0 for the whole window (default 100)' '--theme:dark, light, tokyonight, nightfox, gruvbox-material or plain (default\: from COLORFGBG; plain when NO_COLOR is set)' '--transparent:draw on the terminal'\''s own background (opacity, blur)\: on, popups (popups and bars) or off (default; TUI_MARKDOWN_TRANSPARENT=1|popups|0)' '--scale:H1 as scaled text (OSC 66)\: on, off or auto (from the environment\: kitty)' '--links:OSC 8 hyperlinks\: on, off or auto (from the environment\: not Terminal.app or a dumb terminal)' '--sync:synchronized output (DEC 2026, asked of the terminal first)\: on, off or auto' '--colors:16, 256 or 24bit (default\: from the terminal)' '--zebra:shade alternate table rows' '--numbers:line numbers in code blocks' '--side:open with the outline sidebar' '--mode:start in preview, source or live (default preview)' '--edit:start in live mode (same as --mode live)' '--smart:smart typography while typing\: curly quotes, en dashes, ellipses' '--no-watch:do not reload when the file changes' '--completions:print a shell completion script (bash, zsh or fish) and exit' '--help:show this help' '--version:print the version and exit') ;;
        esac
        _describe 'option' choices
    else
        _files
    fi
}
compdef _tui_markdown tui-markdown
